source_key_rule: record_key identifies the batch and original process directory. Append a source_file_sha256 filename to identify one original source record.
hash_scope: Source SHA256 values cover exact original bytes before location removal. Product SHA256 values cover the distributed sanitized files.

measurement_fields.B_ms: Original driver method_build_ms. Loading and orientation are separate raw fields.
measurement_fields.q_ms: Original driver query_ms_mean across measured_queries. Warmup queries are excluded.
measurement_fields.persistent_bytes: Original driver index_bytes_est with its original index_bytes_kind.
measurement_fields.max_rss_kib: External whole-process peak resident set size reported by GNU time.
measurement_fields.seed: Exact original integer encoded as a decimal string for readers with limited integer precision.
measurement_fields.status: Terminal analysis category. raw_status preserves the original wrapper result.
measurement_fields.censored: True for a timeout or resource failure. Component measurements remain null when absent.

sanitization: Absolute executable, query, output and raw-log locations are removed.
Launch commands are removed. Portable measurement arguments are retained in planned_parameters.
Recorded source hash entries use a basename and JSON pointer into the source manifest.
Raw stderr and GNU-time command text are excluded. Their original byte hashes are retained.
The wrapper driver payload and original JSON stdout are retained. Standard JSON numeric decoding agrees between them.
Operational load-average raw text is removed. Numeric load values remain in original_record.
Historical protocol prose receives terminology and punctuation normalization. Numeric data and method identifiers are preserved.
gaps: Twenty-eight processes have no driver payload. They comprise sixteen controlled timeouts and twelve extension Score memory failures.
B, q, measured output counts and persistent storage are null for those processes.
The sixteen timeout wrappers also lack peak RSS values.
Resource-failure wall time supplies no component-time bound.
Binary and code identities are recorded manifest hashes. Historical executable bytes are absent from this compact evidence set.
Large prepared datasets are absent from this compact evidence set.
Extension resource classifications were recorded after the first allocation failure. Their raw unexpected_exit statuses and hashes remain available.
